与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:杰克的经历、感受与成长。
The green hill looked quieter than usual that evening. David and Jack are preparing a report about the green hill. At first, Jack found it difficult to keep the habit. The drought dried up the river.

Jack's dream job is to be a nurse. The experience taught Jack more than any book could. Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Best of all, the gardener planted flowers in a large stone urn.

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. People around Jack often share different ideas about the green hill. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The compost heap steams on cold mornings.

Little by little, things began to change. Jack plans to study music harder this term. The plant garden has become an important part of daily life. What's more, my new laptop has a fast processor for editing videos.
Jack thanked David for the honest advice. On Saturday evenings, Jack reviews the notes from class. Jack wrote down every idea in a small notebook.
